mechanism.claim: A broad four-hour move across liquid alt perpetuals with BTC moving less in absolute terms identifies cross-alt price discovery not yet assimilated by BTC. In a high-variation BTC regime, follow the alt majority through the next eight-hour interval.
mechanism.side: strict majority sign of six completed alt returns
mechanism.why_distinct: CABLR required BTC to move in the opposite direction over an eight-hour block; CABER faded confirmed BTC-alt moves; flow-leadership candidates used trade flow. CABUR requires magnitude underreaction, not sign disagreement or confirmation, on independent four-hour blocks and reuses no event set or control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed prior-24h BTC realized variation must rank in its causal upper 35%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: three fixed 04:05/12:05/20:05 UTC cross-alt underreaction clocks are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.blocks: exact 240 one-minute bars for all seven symbols over [00:00,04:00), [08:00,12:00), or [16:00,20:00) UTC
features.returns: log(last close/first open) per symbol; qualifying alt returns strict nonzero
features.breadth: at least four of six alt return signs equal one strict majority sign
features.alt_impulse: median absolute return across six alts
features.alt_impulse_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 valid blocks, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.70
features.btc_underreaction: absolute BTC block return is strictly less than alt_impulse
features.btc_realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared BTC 1m close-to-close returns over exact 24 hours ending at decision)
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 valid decisions, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.decision: exact 04:00,12:00,20:00 UTC after four-hour block completion
clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not an input; exact funding only after novelty

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes all four stages

source_plan.execution_price: sealed until source and novelty pass

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no universe, block, breadth, impulse, underreaction, rank, side, clock, hold, subset, or control repair
